name: Dust

abilityDetails.Glancing: Sıyırma vuruşları kritik olamaz, %50 azalmış hasar verir ve saldırı yetenek doğruluğu %100 düşer.
abilityDetails.Disable Willpower: Rakibin İrade Gücü ustalık yenilenmesini devre dışı bırakır.
abilityDetails.Power Efficiency: Özel saldırıların güç maliyetini belirtilen güçte azaltır.
abilityDetails.Grit: Unstoppable rakipler, vuruşlara sanki Unstoppable değillermiş gibi tepki verir.
abilityDetails.Physical Vulnerability: Fiziksel Direnci azaltarak saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen fiziksel hasarı artırır.
abilityDetails.Passive Stun: Belirli şartlarda rakibi tetikleme olmadan sersemletir.
abilityDetails.Steadfast: Aktifken, Unblockable saldırılar sanki değillermiş gibi bloklanabilir.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Bloğa veya orta vuruşlara fazla vurma — kum debuff'ı biriktirir, 4 dolunca can kaybettiren bir moda girer. E1'i mutlaka kaçır (bloklanırsa 2 kum debuff'ı ekler). Yakma veya plazma efekti bir kum debuff'ını siler — sık yakma/plazma erişimi olan şampiyonlar tam kontra. Fiziksel dirençli şampiyonlar (en iyisi Absorbing Man) da iyi.

abilitySections.title: Sentient Storm - Always Active
content: Dust is Immune to Bleed, Poison, and Shock effects.
Dust's Light and Heavy Attacks do not make contact with the Opponent.
Incoming attacks during Dust's Well-Timed Block window have a 100% chance to Glance. As a Defender, this triggers for any incoming Basic Attack as long as Dust is Blocking.
If the Opponent has the Willpower Mastery active, it is removed.

abilitySections.title: Sand Effects
content: Whenever the Opponent or their Block is struck by a Medium Attack or has a hit Glance, they are inflicted with a Sand Debuff for 6 seconds.
Punishing a Heavy Attack or Special Attack with a Light or Medium Attack inflicts 2 Sand Debuffs for 6 seconds.

When the Opponent Purifies a Debuff, Dust deals a burst of [1,055.9] Physical Damage and inflicts 1 indefinite Sand Passive. If the Purified Debuff was a Sand Debuff, 2 additional Sand Passives are inflicted.
As an Attacker, Dust's Light Attacks Purify her most recently inflicted personal Debuff on the Opponent on hit.
Inflicting Dust with an Incinerate or Plasma effect will crystalize her sand, removing 1 Sand effect from her Opponent.

abilitySections.title: Sandstorm
content: As an Attacker, when Dust performs a Heavy Attack, she spins up a Sandstorm for 16 seconds. When finished, Sandstorm goes on cooldown for 8 seconds.
As a Defender, when Dust's Opponent reaches 4 Sand effects, Dust spins up a Sandstorm for 8 seconds. This Sandstorm does not have a cooldown.

When a Sandstorm is spun up, Dust removes all Sand effects on the Opponent. For each effect removed, Dust gains a 3.5% Prowess Passive until the Sandstorm ends. Sandstorm and its Prowess effects are not affected by Ability Accuracy modification. Max Prowess: 99.

abilitySections.title: While Sandstorm is active
content: Whenever Dust would inflict a Sand effect, she instead gains an additional Prowess Passive, and a Power Efficiency Passive reducing the cost of Special Attacks by 3% for 8 seconds. Dust's Light Attacks pause these Power Efficiency Passives for 0.3 seconds.
As an Attacker, the Opponent's Basic Attacks have a 60% chance to Glance when hitting Dust's Block.
Opponents are dealt [1,478.26] Physical Damage every second. This damage scales with Base Attack only and is reduced by 60% while the Opponent is Blocking.
Dust gains a Grit Passive.
Sandstorm is paused during the Opponent's Special Attacks and expires 50% slower during Dust's Special Attacks. Additionally, Sandstorm cannot end during Dust's Special Attacks.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: Each hit inflicts 1 Sand Debuff for 6 seconds. These can be inflicted through Block. The final 2 hits inflict an additional Sand Debuff.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: The final 3 hits each inflict a [239.13] Physical Vulnerability Debuff for 20 seconds. If these Debuffs are Purified, they are replaced with Passive versions with their potency increased by 50%.
If Sandstorm is active, the final hit inflicts a Stun Passive for 2 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: This Special Attack does not consume Power, but cannot be activated while Sandstorm or its cooldown are active.
This Special Attack spins up a Sandstorm for 22 seconds. This Sandstorm does not have a cooldown.

abilitySections.title: Signature Ability - Turaab
content: When either Champion's Combo Meter reaches a multiple of 10, Dust has a [60 - 100]% chance to inflict a Sand Debuff for 6 seconds.
When fighting against Skill Champions and while Sandstorm is active, Dust gains a Steadfast Passive.
